# Differential cases for the box-file passes and writers of G3's
# olympia/io.c (fast_scan, scan_boxes, scan_chars, scan_all_boxes,
# read_boxes, read_chars, read_all_boxes, open_write_fp, write_kind,
# write_player, write_chars, write_leftovers, write_all_boxes and
# write_master), at G3 ab24d451ee25d61364e08cde1fbfc223e220fbd1.
#
# tools/boxfile-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in boxfile-c-output.txt;
# TestBoxfileMatchesC feeds it to the Go port and requires the same output.
#
# Each "section NAME" line starts a section. Every section runs in a fresh
# process (a fresh world, after glob_init()) in a fresh, empty directory,
# with umask 022, so a section may end in a crash, and the files it writes
# are its own. libdir starts as "lib", which a section makes if it wants
# one. run.sh adds how the section ended, "exit STATUS" or "hang" (see
# run.sh), and then the directory's tree, every file with its mode and
# contents. stderr goes to the same place as stdout, in order.
#
# One operation per line; a line that starts with '#' is a comment, and
# blank lines are skipped. N, K, SK, P and MODE are integers, read with
# strtol(s, NULL, 0) and stored in a C int. TEXT is the rest of the line
# after one space, with \xHH and \\ escapes; with no space it is empty.
# NAME is one word. Strings print with bytes outside ' '..'~', and '\', as
# \xHH, and NULL prints as NULL.
#
#   alloc N K SK        alloc_box(N, K, SK)
#   delete N            delete_box(N)
#   name N TEXT         set_name(N, TEXT)
#   unit PL N           append N to p_player(PL)->units
#   lord N K            p_char(N)->unit_lord = K
#   pretty P            pretty_data_files = P
#   win P               win_flag = P
#   libdir TEXT         libdir = TEXT
#   put NAME TEXT       append TEXT to file NAME
#   putl NAME TEXT      append TEXT and a newline to file NAME
#   mkdir TEXT          mkdir(TEXT, 0755)
#   chmod MODE TEXT     chmod(TEXT, MODE)
#   line                print line
#   boxes               print every box (number, kind, subkind and temp),
#                       then every non-empty kind chain, in chain order
#   fast                fast_scan(), and its result
#   scan NAME           scan_boxes(NAME)
#   scanchars           scan_chars()
#   scanall             scan_all_boxes()
#   read NAME           read_boxes(NAME)
#   readchars           read_chars()
#   readall             read_all_boxes()
#   writekind K NAME    write_kind(K, NAME)
#   writeplayer N       write_player(N)
#   writechars          write_chars()
#   leftovers           write_leftovers()
#   writeall            write_all_boxes()
#   master              write_master()
#
# fact/ holds at most one file in each section that has diagnostics, since
# readdir()'s order is the file system's.
#
# Kinds: 1 player, 2 char, 3 loc, 4 item, 5 skill, 6 gate, 7 road,
# 8 deadchar, 9 ship, 10 post, 11 storm, 12 unform, 13 lore. Subkinds:
# 3 plain, 14 city, 30 galley, 49 pl_regular.

section fast_scan
mkdir lib
putl lib/master 1001\x091.49\x09fact/1001\x09Player one
putl lib/master 1002\x092.0\x09fact/1001\x09Noble
putl lib/master 10101  \x09 \x093.14\x09loc\x09\x09City
putl lib/master 10102\x093
putl lib/master 10103 3.x
putl lib/master 10104x4.5.6
putl lib/master 78\x094.300
putl lib/master 79 7.\x092
put lib/master 80\x0912.0
fast
boxes
line

section fast_scan with no master
mkdir lib
fast
boxes

section fast_scan of an empty master
mkdir lib
put lib/master
fast
boxes

section fast_scan of a blank line
mkdir lib
putl lib/master 1001\x091.49\x09fact/1001\x09Player one
putl lib/master
putl lib/master 1002\x092.0\x09fact/1001\x09Noble
fast

section fast_scan of a duplicate box
mkdir lib
putl lib/master 1001\x091.49
putl lib/master 1001\x092.0
fast

section fast_scan of a comment
mkdir lib
putl lib/master # a comment
fast

section fast_scan with libdir elsewhere
mkdir data
putl data/master 1001\x091.49
libdir data
fast
boxes

section scan_boxes
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc # a comment before the first box
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc na City
putl lib/loc # a comment inside a box
putl lib/loc LI
putl lib/loc  wh 10102
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10102 LOC Plain
putl lib/loc  \x09
putl lib/loc 10103 loc 0
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10104 loc 0x
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10105 loc faery hill
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10106 Loc   city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10107 location city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10108 loc town
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10109 loc
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10110
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10111\x09loc city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10112 deleted 0
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc #
putl lib/loc 10113 item 0
put lib/loc na no blank line at the end
scan loc
boxes

section scan_boxes of a missing file
mkdir lib
scan loc
boxes

section scan_boxes of a blank line between boxes
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10102 loc city
scan loc

section scan_boxes of a box number 0
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc abc loc city
scan loc

section scan_boxes of a duplicate box
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/item 10101 item 0
scan loc
scan item

section scan_chars
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
putl lib/fact/1001 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/fact/1001 na Player one
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1002 char 0
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1003 chars 0
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/x 1004 char 0
putl lib/fact/.1005 1005 char 0
mkdir lib/fact/9
scanchars
boxes

section scan_chars with no fact
mkdir lib
scanchars
boxes

section scan_chars when fact is a file
mkdir lib
putl lib/fact 1001 player pl_regular
scanchars

section scan_chars of an unreadable fact
mkdir lib
mkdir lib/fact
putl lib/fact/1001 1001 player pl_regular
chmod 0 lib/fact
scanchars
chmod 0755 lib/fact

section scan_all_boxes
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/item 10 item 0
putl lib/item
putl lib/skill 600 skill 0
putl lib/skill
putl lib/gate 20000 gate 0
putl lib/gate
putl lib/road 20001 road 0
putl lib/road
putl lib/ship 20002 ship galley
putl lib/ship
putl lib/unform 20003 unform 0
putl lib/unform
putl lib/misc 20004 storm 0
putl lib/misc
putl lib/misc 20005 post 0
putl lib/misc
mkdir lib/fact
putl lib/fact/1001 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1002 char 0
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1003 deadchar 0
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1004 lore 0
scanall
boxes

section scan_all_boxes with no files
mkdir lib
scanall
boxes

section read_boxes
mkdir lib
alloc 10101 3 14
alloc 10102 3 3
alloc 10103 3 3
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc na City
putl lib/loc LI
putl lib/loc  wh 10102
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc   10102 loc plain
putl lib/loc na Plain
putl lib/loc
put lib/loc 10103 xyz 0
read loc
line
writekind 3 loc
boxes

section read_boxes with a continued field on the last line
mkdir lib
alloc 10101 3 14
alloc 10102 3 3
alloc 10103 3 3
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc na City
putl lib/loc LI
putl lib/loc  hl 10102 \\
putl lib/loc \x0910103 \\
read loc
line
writekind 3 loc

section read_boxes of a missing file
mkdir lib
read loc
line

section read_boxes of a comment line
mkdir lib
alloc 10101 3 14
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc na City
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc # a comment
putl lib/loc 10102 loc city
read loc

section read_boxes of a comment line first
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc # a comment
read loc

section read_boxes of a blank line between boxes
mkdir lib
alloc 10101 3 14
alloc 10102 3 14
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10102 loc city
read loc

section read_boxes of a line that is not a box
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc loc 10101 city
read loc

section read_boxes of a negative box number
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc -10101 loc city
read loc

section read_boxes of an unforseen box
mkdir lib
alloc 10101 3 14
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10102 loc city
read loc

section write_kind

section round trip
mkdir lib
putl lib/loc 10101 loc city
putl lib/loc na City
putl lib/loc LI
putl lib/loc  wh 10102
putl lib/loc  hl 1002
putl lib/loc
putl lib/loc 10102 loc plain
putl lib/loc na Plain
putl lib/loc LI
putl lib/loc  hl 10101
putl lib/loc
putl lib/road 20001 road 0
putl lib/road na Road
putl lib/road GA
putl lib/road  tl 10102
putl lib/road
putl lib/misc 20004 storm 0
putl lib/misc
mkdir lib/fact
putl lib/fact/1001 1001 player pl_regular
putl lib/fact/1001 na Player one
putl lib/fact/1001 PL
putl lib/fact/1001  un 1002
putl lib/fact/1001
putl lib/fact/1001 1002 char 0
putl lib/fact/1001 na Noble
putl lib/fact/1001 LI
putl lib/fact/1001  wh 10101
putl lib/fact/1001 CH
putl lib/fact/1001  lo 1001
putl lib/fact/1001
scanall
readall
writeall
master
boxes
